newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle market quiet, no sales -trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle market quiet, no sales -trade.

text.p: Nebraska cattle markets near midday Monday were quiet, with no reported sales, according to market sources.
No bids were noted, with the exception of a few at $68.00 per cwt on a live basis, against asking levels of $71.00, they said. Last trades Friday in the live market were $70.00-$71.00.
Owners were asking $115.00 on a dressed basis, steady to up $1.00 from light sales on Friday.
The showlist was expected to be about unchanged from last week, the sources said.
